relevance_note: Single-patient case report of SSADH deficiency with an identifiable child: "We report on a five-year-old male patient, homozygous for the pathogenic variant (NM_170740:c.1265G>A) in ALDH5A1".
method_note: Read the whole Markdown full text (abstract, introduction, case report, discussion, references); the paper has no tables and no 'Supplementary material' section, so no stacked cells and no script-transcribed tables. In scope: the single patient (label 'patient', rule 5) and the two parents, who are described only in relation to him ('firstborn from a non-consanguineous marriage', 'The parents reported the absence of appropriate reactions to sound'); they have no individual-level data, no test and no variant. Previously published patients (e.g. 'Patients homozygous for c.1265G>A were reported from diverse ethnic backgrounds') are group-level only and get no rows. Contradictions/notes: (1) the variant is printed with a space after the colon in the case report ('NM_170740: c.1265G>A') and without it in the discussion/abstract ('NM_170740:c.1265G>A'); (2) the age of the brain MRI is inconsistent ('At eight months of age' context, figure legend 'at the age of 15 months', discussion 'at 20 months of age') - the finding is the same (incomplete myelination, globi pallidi hyperintensity); (3) the onset of hypotonia is given as 'shortly after birth' (case report) and 'early infancy' (discussion). Judgement calls: the checklist item 'obsessive-compulsive traits' is marked excluded from 'disabling obsessive-compulsive disorder ... Similar manifestations have not been encountered yet in the boy we present'; 'intellectual disability' is marked observed from 'severe psychomotor developmental delay' and 'mild improvement in cognitive functions'; functional_evidence_statement uses the sentence about 'the same genotype' as the patient's; is_proband = false for the two parents has span null (nothing quotable states a negative).
